event.goal: Two engine snapshots mint different UUID-shaped map keys for the same logical records. collapse_uuid_keys must make those snapshots comparable: every UUID-shaped key is replaced with a placeholder <uuid>, <uuid>1>, and so on. The current implementation last-wins onto a single <uuid> key, so the surviving value depends on input order. Collect every UUID-keyed value, sort them, and re-key deterministically so equal value multisets compare equal regardless of entry order. Non-UUID keys such as keep must be preserved.
